title: Morden Emergency Help Points
summary: Offline guide to 24-hour A&E, urgent care, local hazards, and emergency supplies in Morden.
content:
For any life-threatening emergency, always call 999 immediately (or 112).

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals:
- St Helier Hospital, Wrythe Lane, Carshalton, SM5 1AA.
Travel: From Morden Underground station, it is approximately a 25-minute walk (1.2 miles) south along London Road and St Helier Avenue, or take bus 80, 93, 154, or 157 directly to the main hospital entrance.
- St George's Hospital, Blackshaw Road, Tooting, SW17 0QT (Major Trauma Centre, ~2.5 miles north; from Morden station take the Northern line to Tooting Broadway or bus 93/118).

2. Urgent Treatment Centre (UTC):
St Helier Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre, Wrythe Lane, Carshalton, SM5 1AA (located next to A&E for non-life-threatening urgent injuries and treatment).

3. Local Area Hazards:
- The River Wandle flows through Morden Hall Park, creating severe localized flooding on surrounding walking routes and adjoining floodplains.
- The Pyl Brook tributary crosses lower Morden, generating surface drainage back-ups across local residential streets.

4. Essential Supplies During Outages:
Pharmacies and supermarkets situated on London Road (Morden town centre), Crown Lane, and Aberconway Road provide bottled water, over-the-counter medicine, and first-aid kits.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
